name: nightly-check
about: A deadline hits a rung of its ladder today and there is no task app: the brief must go to the outbox, never through Gmail.
db_setup: insert into email_processing_runs (skill_version, started_at, run_at, notes) values ('v3.3', now() - interval '2 hours', now() - interval '2 hours', 'tonight')
insert into processing_runs (skill_version, started_at, run_at, notes) values ('v3.3', now() - interval '1 hour', now() - interval '1 hour', 'tonight')

insert into documents (drive_file_id, name, drive_url, document_type_key, subject_person, expiry_date, status, last_intake_at) values ('f-passport', 'Passport.pdf', 'https://drive.test/f-passport', 'passport', 'Test Owner', current_date + 7, 'current', clock_timestamp())

insert into deadlines (title, deadline_type, due_on, hard, lead_days, source_kind, source_id, status, notes, date_basis) select 'Passport expires', 'document_expiry', current_date + 7, true, '{30,14,7,1}', 'document', id, 'open', 'basis: stated', 'stated' from documents where drive_file_id = 'f-passport'

sql.why: exactly one brief row for today
sql.q: select count(*) = 1 from briefings where briefing_date = current_date

sql.why: the brief went to the outbox
sql.q: select count(*) = 1 from briefings b join outbox o on o.id = b.outbox_id where b.briefing_date = current_date and b.channel = 'email' and o.kind = 'brief'

sql.why: the brief's subject keeps the English marker
sql.q: select count(*) = 1 from outbox where kind = 'brief' and subject ilike '%Daily brief%'
select count(*) = 1 from outbox where kind = 'brief' and body ilike '%passport%'
select count(*) = 1 from run_locks where skill_name = 'nightly-check' and expires_at <= now()
